data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Australia, I'd narrow it down to **Stripe, Shopify Payments, and PayPal**\.

My overall recommendation is **Stripe** if you're starting an independent online store. It's easy to set up, has no standard monthly processing fee, supports international customers, and integrates with most ecommerce platforms.

However, the best option depends on which platform you're using.

## Best payment processors compared

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Australian domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent for WooCommerce and custom stores
- Supports subscriptions, Apple Pay and Google Pay
  
  [Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No separate payment gateway required
- Supports cards and digital wallets
- Simple order and refund management
  
  [Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best as an additional option)

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Offers PayPal checkout and eligible card payments
- Useful for international customers
- Can have higher transaction fees
  
  [PayPal Australia Business](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Airwallex**

- Attractive for international sales
- Multi-currency accounts and settlements
- Integrates with ecommerce platforms
- Worth considering if you sell overseas
  
  [Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

The indicative Australian rates above are based on published 2026 comparisons; check each provider's current pricing and eligibility before signing up. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Just starting out | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Using WooCommerce | Stripe |
| Selling internationally | Stripe or Airwallex |
| Want customers to have more checkout choices | Add PayPal |


**One important tip\:** If you're using Shopify, check the additional transaction fees for external payment providers. Shopify Payments can be cheaper overall because it avoids Shopify's third-party transaction surcharge. [www.hackceleration.com](https://www.hackceleration.com/labs/best/payment-gateway-ecommerce?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
